description_en: Modifies the web data quality collection configuration
description_zh: 修改网页数据质量采集配置
name: UpdatePerformanceDataCollection

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable quality data collection. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启质量数据采集开关。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: enable
